|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Bib Fortuna (V)]] (version 2 of 2). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114001541/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114001541id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploys free to opponent's Audience Chamber. May deploy [Jabba's Palace] No Bargain from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While with Jabba, Bib is power +2 and Jabba is immune to attrition. While at Audience Chamber, I Must Be Allowed To Speak may not target this site.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Bib Fortuna (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Bib Fortuna (Jabba’s Palace)”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Bib Fortuna (V)]] (repository revision 9 April 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Bib Fortuna]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
